description: Ten real photographs of the west facade of Notre-Dame de Paris selected from Wikimedia Commons for a bounded WRE sparse-reconstruction preview.

download_policy.note: The committed demo inputs are Wikimedia-generated resized derivatives at a standard cached thumbnail width. The 10-image subset keeps the current CPU/single-thread exhaustive matching baseline tractable while preserving the exact WRE L3.2-L3.6 workflow. Source pages and license metadata are retained in resolved_sources.json.
